lines: bellhop's Pi extension listens on <runtime_dir>/pi-<pid>.sock and delivers into the session.
Pi loads every *.ts in that directory at start; run /reload in a running Pi.
or load it for one run: pi -e <exported dir>/bellhop.ts
hooklinesinker 1.5.1 lists Pi only when it runs through an executable named pi (ADR 0002).
